### Consolidated Water Sets Investor Conference Call to Discuss Third Quarter 2026 Results on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. ET


10/26/2026


GEORGE TOWN, Grand Cayman, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Consolidated Water Co. Ltd](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=b-_7jOjj1fARxjl0oELjzMOViBlN4Cvf_2aRnuphPxeFBNb3Uh9jjK9_-6ahiJaofFG3rTzhvBTLUS_4zDFfK5hp7Yo-A72Fy_y5Ek9dFuw=) . (NASDAQ Global Select Market: CWCO), a leading designer, builder and operator of advanced water treatment plants, will hold a conference call on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern time to discuss its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


The financial results will be issued in a press release prior to the call. Consolidated Water management will host the call, followed by a question-and-answer period.


Date: Tuesday, November 10, 2026
Time: 11:00 a.m. Eastern time (8:00 a.m. Pacific time)
Toll-free dial-in number: 1-844-875-6913
International dial-in number: 1-412-317-6709
Participant web phone:[click here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sIEAY_GgsgTuGBDEEpwaYmDMCI-Jx0W6mzjBKt1U9nKWZdq0k3KQtim0KVwqxC_fTvuryJPsHrmJ7H7oRikuj2UiuW_tECiaH1KIQg-f_GyMSI5CvDHt4DkWDQ3rMEIkIIjzx7dbtuEZUbiRhOltFMFnV4Evo0nWWNRMJKsY3Yc=)


Please call the conference telephone number five minutes prior to the start time. An operator will register your name and organization. If you require any assistance connecting with the call, please contact Encore at 1-949-432-7450.


A replay of the call will be available after 1:00 p.m. Eastern time on the same day through November 17, 2026, as well as available for replay via the Investors section of the Consolidated Water website at[www.cwco.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pZSv64n_MIfLNnN99foSgYkQPPTpddp9fk_5dl0FGVh6B0pME9EsGBLV9xEydK1d0VkWEFsaQoUb8vm7dXmPJA==) .


Toll-free replay number: 1-855-669-9658
International replay number: 1-412-317-0088
Replay ID: 5866966


**About Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.**
Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. develops and operates advanced water treatment plants and water distribution systems. The company designs, constructs and operates seawater desalination facilities in the Cayman Islands, The Bahamas and the British Virgin Islands, and designs, constructs and operates water treatment and reuse facilities in the United States.


The company also manufactures and services a wide range of products and provides design, engineering, management, operating and other services applicable to commercial and municipal water production, supply and treatment, and industrial water and wastewater treatment.


For more information, visit[cwco.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=LaAmZ9eHOBEh68rKxJ4N8fagkYAPlZKLInSMH9OfEiP_sDX9K7EKk6UOcrLuGvAbU443U1bvoxMAIrH3ysGyUw==) .
